init.title: MCP access and tools
init.description:
**Connection URL:** `{url}`

**claude.ai:** add a custom connector with this URL and sign in with the allowed Home Assistant user.

**Claude Code:** create a long-lived access token as the allowed user (Profile > Security), then run:

`{claude_code}`

Only the tools switched on below are visible and callable. Default: read-only tools.

**New since the options were last saved (still off):** {new_tools}

data_description.enabled_tools: Changes apply immediately, without a restart.
data_description.max_attachment_mb: Largest file gmx_get_attachment and gmx_get_raw_message return (1–10 MB). claude.ai accepts only about 110 KB per answer; Claude Code up to the limit.
data_description.max_upload_mb: Largest file (and sum of all files) per call that gmx_save_draft and gmx_send_message accept (1–20 MB). The model has to output the file as base64; large files make the call slow.
data_description.allow_html_output: Lets gmx_get_message return cleaned HTML (format html). Off: text only.
data_description.allow_permanent_delete: Lets gmx_delete_permanently remove mails in the trash or spam folder for good. Off: only the trash.
data_description.max_delete_per_day: Mails per local day that gmx_trash and gmx_delete_permanently may delete together. 0 = no limit (default). Each call takes at most 50 mails.
data_description.tools_without_confirmation: These tools act on the first call, without preview and confirmation code. Risk: a single misled instruction then deletes or sends at once. Default: none.
data_description.send_mode: Only the allowlist: an empty list means nothing can be sent. Any address: every recipient is allowed (the list stays stored for switching back). The sending tools themselves are switched on above.
data_description.allowlist: One entry per line (or separated by commas): an exact address (anna@example.org) or a whole domain (*@example.org, without subdomains). Used in the mode "only the allowlist".
data_description.allow_reply_to_sender: Lets gmx_reply answer the sender (From) of any received mail even if it is not on the allowlist. Risk: a crafted mail gets a way out if the model falls for it. A different Reply-To address and further recipients always need the allowlist. Default: off.
data_description.sender_name: Optional display name before the account address (max. 100 characters). Recommended: mails without a name ended up in GMX spam in a test.
data_description.sent_copy_mode: GMX stores no copy when sending via SMTP. Append: the integration always stores one (default). Auto: only if none is found. None: no copy.
data_description.max_recipients: To, Cc and Bcc together, at least 1. Default 10.
data_description.max_send_per_day: Mails per local day across all sending tools. 0 = no limit. Default 20. GMX does not publish its limits; many mails risk a block of the account.
data_description.max_recipients_per_hour: Recipients in the last 60 minutes across all sending tools. 0 = no limit. Default 10 (an unconfirmed source names 11 per hour as GMX limit).
data_description.max_message_size_mb: Largest message including attachments that the sending tools send (1–100 MB). Default 20 MB (GMX FreeMail limit).
data_description.audit_retention_days: Days (1–365) an audit entry is kept; at most 5000 entries. Entries contain no mail content, subjects or addresses.

error.invalid_allowlist_entry: The allowlist contains an entry that is neither an address nor *@domain.
error.wildcard_not_allowed: "*" is not an allowlist entry; choose "Any address" instead.
error.invalid_sender_name: The sender name is too long (max. 100 characters) or contains < > " or control characters.

options.gmx_get_attachment: Read: get an attachment as text or file (gmx_get_attachment)
options.gmx_get_audit_log: Read: audit log of writing calls (gmx_get_audit_log)
options.gmx_move: Organise: move mails, not into the trash (gmx_move)
options.gmx_copy: Organise: copy mails, not into the trash (gmx_copy)
options.gmx_mark_spam: Organise: mark as spam – GMX deletes spam after 30 days (gmx_mark_spam)
options.gmx_save_draft: Organise: save drafts, with attachments; does not send (gmx_save_draft)
options.gmx_trash: Delete: move mails into the trash (gmx_trash)
options.gmx_delete_permanently: Delete: delete mails in trash/spam for good – needs the option below (gmx_delete_permanently)
options.gmx_forward: Send: forward a mail with its attachments (gmx_forward)
options.gmx_send_draft: Send: send a draft and remove it from Drafts (gmx_send_draft)

options.auto: Store a copy if none is found

imap_possibly_disabled.title: GMX login rejected for {account}
imap_possibly_disabled.description: GMX rejected the login. GMX switches IMAP access off after a period without use, and then reports a wrong password. Enable "POP3 and IMAP access" in the GMX settings again, then re-authenticate the integration (new app password if it was revoked).

new_tools_available.title: New tools available for {account}
new_tools_available.description: An update added tools that stay off until you switch them on: {tools}. Open Settings > Devices & services > GMX Mail MCP > Configure, choose the tools you want and save. This notice then disappears, even if you switch nothing on.

smtp_auth_failed.title: GMX rejected the SMTP login for {account}
smtp_auth_failed.description: Sending failed because GMX rejected the login (app password revoked or changed). Nothing was sent. Re-authenticate the integration with a valid app password.
